mapper.select: select team_id, activity_id, notify_mq, notify_status, notify_count, parameter_json from group_buy_notify_task where notify_status in (0, 2) limit 50
mapper.insert: insert into group_buy_notify_task(team_id, activity_id, notify_mq, notify_status, notify_count, parameter_json, create_time, update_time) values(#{teamId}, #{activityId}, #{notifyMq}, #{notifyStatus}, #{notifyCount}, #{parameterJson}, now(), now())
mapper.update: update group_buy_notify_task set notify_status = 1, update_time = now() where team_id = #{teamId} and notify_status in (0, 2)
update group_buy_notify_task set notify_count = notify_count + 1, notify_status = 2, update_time = now() where team_id = #{teamId} and notify_status in (0, 2)
update group_buy_notify_task set notify_count = notify_count + 1, notify_status = 3, update_time = now() where team_id = #{teamId} and notify_status in (0, 2)
